reviewer: Codex/root, separate source/cost/red-team pass; same agent, not a second independent human reviewer
budget: Original2h checkpoints/standing finite extensions; no new timing experiment or public tool changes.

cost_ledger.changed: Per immutable version backing is32+8*(requests+1)+4*page_refs+(paged?4*requests:0) bytes, plus the existing allocator/lease/mapping/control ownership. No max-capacity zeroing unless explicit export.
cost_ledger.retained_cost: Each successful version allocates active backing and control, copies active metadata, performs generation CAS and retains owners. Fixed-capacity metadata()/indices() explicitly allocate/zero/copy once and lock their cache on repeated calls; no whole-step allocation-free claim.

cost_ledger.changed: Compare at most the old/new active extent; at most five word ranges for common wire fields, one actual changed-ID interval for the selected native bank. Clear only old active suffix and changed spans.
cost_ledger.retained_cost: CPU scanning remains O(active requests+page refs), an interval may contain unchanged interior words. Cold staging/mirrors have full fixed capacity; native uses two truthful per-bank identities. Common changed upload incurs one original checked F2 host wait.

cost_ledger.changed: The first prepared node uploads shared metadata once; later same-input/generation/resource nodes use the original checked-ready mirror before their own native planning.
cost_ledger.retained_cost: Each node still owns workspace/planning and its necessary waits. Existing complete-node-set validation has a worst-case cubic node search; the exact line predates G06 at baseline10129. Group/lookup passes remain quadratic in node count, separate from page admission. No linear whole-Graph prepare, all-shape latency or peer parity claim.
proof: evidence/correctness/inference-g06-common-source-windows-attempt-4/receipt.json two dependent actual attention nodes, reversed NodeLayout order and three numeric/upload episodes

cost_ledger.changed: Cold-reserved pointer scratch sorts the full admitted group by lease block identity, validates generation/permission and invokes the original unique/ordered unique F1 primitives once per unique group entry. O(G log G) comparisons plus O(G) original permission operations; warm scratch growth prohibited. Both Graph admission layers included in669.
cost_ledger.retained_cost: Scratch Entry is two pointers (16 bytes on qualified64-bit machines), vector control lives in private owners. Original per-block domain locks/refcounts/atomics, pending validation, lane waits and retirement remain; readonly guards in distinct layers/lanes can remain balanced duplicates. No permission bypass or process/native allocation certificate.
proof: LeaseSubmission.ReorderedLargeGroupsDeduplicateAllBlocksWithoutWarmAllocation:256 distinct blocks,64 rebind/reorder/shrink episodes and independent active-use census

cost_ledger.changed: Q1 fixed-Q topology updates actual paged IDs/tails and ragged extents/packed offsets on the original graph/pool/workspace. O(requests+page refs) facts, no per-token native replan in qualified same-Q domain.
cost_ledger.retained_cost: Caller snapshot creation and metadata delta/wait stay charged. Changed Q topology/request set genuinely cold replans. Original masks/kernels and private scratch semantics remain.

cost_ledger.changed: O(requests) comparison at the original actual chunk/CTA/window proves schedule equivalence; reads four-byte chunk fact from original planner host shadow, no D2H. Equivalent runtime metadata skips query/plan/integer-plan upload.
cost_ledger.retained_cost: Crossing chunk/CTA schedule boundary replans; changed metadata still uploads/waits. Q0 no-op preserves explicit immediate-completion accounting. No retile or optimal schedule/total native-private cost claim.

cost_ledger.changed: Fixed schema and complete Q topology retain original Apple/Vulkan C++ Program/Invocation/storage while host-known KV lengths and packed offsets update explicitly. Native paged banks upload actual changed IDs, unchanged IDs have zero upload/wait.
cost_ledger.retained_cost: Apple changed-length execution constructs a managed MLX graph; Vulkan changed scalars invalidate recording and re-encode. Ragged Vulkan contract adds cold shared immutable ownership copied by Recorder. Private native/driver allocation and cost remain UNKNOWN; this is not capture or zero native allocation. The controller explicitly creates a small NativePagedBatchVersion owner for each prepare through the recipe allocator; this can allocate even if an injected invocation allocator sees no new attempt. Caller BatchLayoutVersion backing/control allocations and both sets of lifetime refcounts remain charged.

cost_ledger.changed: Explicit opt-in cold prepare_replay records original CUDA commands without executing caller tensor work or consuming its run token; exact storage/plan can retain the artifact. Run still takes actual F1/Queue/Completion path, idle capture releases page permissions.
cost_ledger.retained_cost: Cold capture checked wait/control allocation charged; changed storage needs explicit recapture and true replan invalidates artifact. CPU explicitly unsupported, Apple managed and Vulkan Recorder retain their own semantics. Graph outer generic capture flag remains false; internal batch atoms have actual limited capture proof.

negative_space: No full engine/model execution/tokenizer/server or tokens-per-second certificate.
No arbitrary topology changes without explicit replan, address changes without recapture, new route/provider domains, CPU capture or native Apple/Vulkan capture inferred from plan reuse.
No hard bound on unknown vendor/driver/private memory and no full-step zero allocation/wait.
Existing outer Graph node validation cost is retained explicitly; a real large-node consumer hotspot/material trace is a scoped reopen trigger, not a speculative extra product FIX.

red_team_findings.finding: Graph two-layer per-page admission remained quadratic after earlier Direct/native optimization.
red_team_findings.disposition: FIXED669; actual256-block independent-use census, source, three WSL host sanitizer facets and six current native Air host facets PASS.

red_team_findings.finding: WSL sanitizer proof cannot stand for changed Apple/Vulkan native host branches.
red_team_findings.disposition: Six actual current Air host facets PASS, original explicit TSan models and scope limits retained; raw artifact SHAs/model bytes rechecked. No WSL proof substituted for a native branch.

red_team_findings.finding: reused_native_plan and no injected HYLE allocation do not imply no managed native graphs/driver cost or no caller snapshot allocation.
red_team_findings.disposition: Keep explicit ledger and update final user guide before usability gate.

red_team_findings.finding: Outer complete-node-set validation has worst-case cubic lookup, distinct from page G.
red_team_findings.disposition: Exact baseline line unchanged; retained in P0 ledger, no newly observed consumer hotspot or material double-key to expand current FIX.

remaining: Final usability/qualification guide and seven-gate aggregate adjudication.
Preserve shared FI original G04/G05 required unresolved P1 while resolving G06-specific terminal/owner state; no whole-goal completion.

performance_decision.reason: The initial G06 closure contract explicitly declares P0/necessary P1. Its finite new promises concern active backing, changed-byte uploads/counts, plan/replan and checked wait counts, exact-page complexity and retention/capture eligibility. Actual report/allocator/oracle observations and source-cost proofs decide those structural promises; no unresolved same-contract timing mechanism has been admitted by this review.
performance_decision.timing_direction: NOT_MEASURED; no 1.0 ratio, throughput parity or speedup claim.
performance_decision.peer_comparison: Pinned SGLang/vLLM/llama.cpp establish the mature active-buffer/shared-input/runtime-plan/capture shapes. Their natural tensor/request owners do not supply HYLE immutable-version/F1 permission/error/actual-retirement contracts, so no same-contract end-to-end peer timing ranking is asserted.
performance_decision.before_after: Original HYLE structural work is checked from the scoped baseline and current source plus actual counter/oracle tests, not a new latency A/B. Reduced capacity work and fewer required uploads/plans are structural conclusions only.
performance_decision.retained_required_p1: G04/G05 qualified kernel-only CUDA prefill remains UNRESOLVED under the original5% time gate and exhausted[15,31] attempt14 contract. No G06 wait/upload/capture observation accepts or resets that original gate.
performance_decision.interpretation: Earlier card paragraphs that generically listed pendingP1 do not define an additional workload/peer/margin; this review resolves the original conditional necessaryP1 step against the finite P0 contract, preserving every explicit timing contract in the goal.
